Approval rates among Hispanic voters have similarly declined. In the latest poll, only 27 percent of Hispanic respondents approved of Trump’s handling of his job as president, while 66 percent disapproved, for a net approval of -39.

Overall, Trump’s net approval rating among all Americans in the latest The Economist/YouGov poll was -10.
